detail: Seeded decided card #billing with why/body, ran `werk quote billing pricing "seats are the unit"`: output contains "proposed", not "added". On /map/billing the [data-link=supported_by] row has data-pending=true and a pending mark; the excerpt page has data-proposed=true, the proposed tag and an Accept button; the card keeps title, status decided, why and body with no [data-diff].

After the quote, opened the excerpt from the card's row and clicked Accept once: data-proposed=false, no proposed tag. On /map/billing the supported_by row (listed in the Say section, link type supported_by) has data-pending=false and no pending mark, with no Accept button left; `werk show billing` has no "held".

Seeded decided #auth-login, ran `werk say auth-login "Should expired links show a retry button?"`, opened /map and clicked the card link. The thread holds one [data-entry=note] with that text and [data-role=author] "agent".

Added ghost #auth-retry, typed the person's note in the page, `werk say` the agent note, `werk discard`, re-added with "Retry reuses the same link". Thread entries: the two notes, then exactly one [data-entry=marker] containing "proposed again"; heading shows the new words; a new typed note "Good, accept" is the 4th entry, below the marker.
Typed "Why 60 seconds?" on ghost #cache-ttl, `werk discard cache-ttl`; `werk inbox` still lists #cache-ttl with the note. After re-adding, the thread shows the note then one marker "proposed again".

Seeded a source and an excerpt.quoted event #src-rfc-quote; `werk say src-rfc-quote "This quote supports the retry decision"` exited 0. /map/src-rfc-quote shows kind "excerpt" and one thread note with that text.

Bare project with 3 cards; spawned two `werk serve --port 0` at once. Exactly one printed an address; the other exited non-zero after >1s (lock wait) with stderr naming the winner's pid and port, and printed no address. The winner's /map shows Root heading and tiles for the two child cards.
Started serve, SIGKILLed it; .werk/serve.lock was left. A new `werk serve` printed its address in under 4s (default live-lock wait is 5s), and /map shows Root and the child card tile.

Two tabs on /map with an EventSource wrapper recording opens and changed events; `werk add second ...` made the tile appear in both tabs with the window marker kept (no reload). After 1s each tab had exactly one changed event with empty data.

Card #invoice added via CLI before the server started; /map shows its tile, and neither the page text nor any response body contains the body text. Clicking the tile shows body, why, status "open" and the parent neighbour "Root" in the refines section.

Accept button on ghost #retry made it real in the page. A raw POST /api/accept without token got 403-class and the log was byte-identical; with the page token but Host evil.example also refused, log unchanged. GET /api/card/retry without token returned 200 with the card.

project() with Child under Root. /map shows h1 "Root" in #left-pane; aside 'Chat' with the Message textbox sits to its right. /map/child shows "Child"; Back shows "Root"; Forward shows "Child". /map/no-such-card shows [data-missing] with a not-found text and #view holds no "Root"/"Child" heading or text (header breadcrumbs not checked).

On /map/root typed "half a thought" in the Message composer, set a window marker, ran `werk add fresh --title "Fresh idea" --parent root`. #view shows "Fresh idea", the marker is still there, the composer still holds the text.

Own server on a bare project with Root; page on /map/root, SIGTERM the server, `werk add offline --title "Written offline"`, restarted serve on the same port. Without any test reload, #view shows "Written offline". Note: the window marker was gone, so the page loaded again by itself (dev-mode Vite reload) rather than only reconnecting its channel; the step only forbids a reload by the person.

Harness copy+hot; edited the 404 text in the copy's src/serve/server.ts. The next request returned the edited text, stderr says "reusing the live server", pid and port unchanged. `werk add after --title "After edit"` shows in #view with the window marker kept and the EventSource open count still 1.

Harness copy+hot on /map/retry, typed "draft that must survive" in the composer, edited the copy's web/main.tsx entry (no HMR accept). The body got data-edited=yes and the window marker was gone (page reloaded by itself); same h1 "Retry a failed payment once" and the composer still holds the draft.
